entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.92 of 2025 pending on the file of learned Addl. District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special court under POCSO Act, arising out of Sukinda P.S. Case No.170 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 363,
376(2)(n), 498A, 494, 323 and 506 of IPC read with Section 4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Section 9 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner undertakes to place on record the FIR in respect of which the final report at Annexure-3 has been submitted.
4. This Court perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 of BNSS.
5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner undertakes to implead the informant as Opposite Party No.2.
Consolidated cause title along with requisites for issuance of notice by Registered Post with A.D. to the newly added Opposite Party shall be filed by 10.09.2025.
Informant be noticed through the I.O..
Extra copy of the brief for the purpose be served on the learned counsel for the State by 10.09.2025 as well.
6. List this matter on 29.10.2025.

Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Biswanath Patra vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55260432/

entities.text: Case Biswanath Patra vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Diary in the meanwhile.
7. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
In the event steps for issuance of notice are not taken, as directed, the interim order shall stand vacated.
8. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
9. Copy of this order be made over to the learned counsel for the State to do the needful.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Jina
